queue.title: SEO-ready brand shell and site foundation

recent_material_fixes.result: The single homepage nights field now submits an exact duration instead of silently widening 7 nights to the default 7-10 range.
The deployed /poisk-turov/ route stays local while not-yet-migrated destinations remain reachable on the active legacy site.
Standalone validation now distinguishes homepage, full-search and legacy routes and keeps live production journey/visual checks postdeploy.
Standalone deploy installs compatible receiver, adapter, pricing helper and idempotency helper together before the HMAC bridge is verified.
anytoour.ru consent links reach the existing privacy page; legacy anytour.online keeps its relative privacy path.
Trip duration stays in the primary mobile search flow and night presets no longer require horizontal scrolling.
V2 does not render a second full footer; social/app destinations remain a compact community pre-footer before one canonical footer.
Invalid child ages stay invalid and block search instead of being silently coerced or dropped.
Unsupported child counts and child-count/age-control mismatches block search instead of sending a different tourist composition.
